mapper.select: select pq.id, pq.paper_id, pq.question_id, pq.title_snapshot, pq.qtype, pq.score, pq.sort_no from jc_edu_paper_question pq where pq.paper_id = #{paperId} order by pq.sort_no, pq.id
mapper.insert:
insert into jc_edu_paper_question (paper_id, question_id, title_snapshot, qtype, score, sort_no) values
(#{item.paperId}, #{item.questionId}, #{item.titleSnapshot}, #{item.qtype}, #{item.score}, #{item.sortNo})
mapper.select: select count(1) from jc_edu_paper_question where paper_id = #{paperId}
